arguments.heading: What happened at the argument
paragraphs: Mr. Sullivan argued the First Amendment claim fails. He cited a lack of a manageable standard.
Mr. Kimberly argued the Court has Article III authority. He cited the First Amendment as the basis.
Mr. Sullivan argued redistricting is inherently political. He questioned how to eliminate all partisanship.
